name: so101-record
description: Record SO-101 teleoperation demonstrations (leader arm, follower arm and one USB camera) as a LeRobot 0.6.1 dataset on the device, and optionally upload it to the Hugging Face Hub.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the recorder's web page (status, countdown, and the next, re-record and stop buttons): open http://<device>:<port> in a browser

variables.name: FOLLOWER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the follower arm (the arm that copies your moves), such as ttyACM0. Check with ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/ on the device. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: LEADER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the leader arm (the arm you move by hand), such as ttyACM1. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: CALIBRATION_VOLUME
variables.description: Persistent volume that holds follower.json and leader.json from the so101-calibration template: <calibration-app-id>-data
